page.layout: One page of text, one column. Above the text, two oval coin medallions side by side (illustrations, not text). Below the text, a decorative ornament (not text). Running head centred at top, page number top right.

main_text.p: AMALASIUNTHA Theodorici filia Athalaricíque Gothorũ Regis mater fuit, cum qua imperauit ipse filius octo annos, auspicatus anno mundi 4488. à Christo nato 526. hæc mortuo filio Athalarico Theodatum cognatum in consortem imperij legit: verum ingratus hic, ac perfidus, eam paulò post relegauit, tandẽ etiam obtruncari iussit: nec ita diu postea imperauit: quinetiã ipsum Optaris occidit: quare Gothi Vitigem Regem crearunt: quẽ captũ Belisarius Rauenna potitus, Constantinopolim duxit. Blondus lib.3. Deca.1. Pau.Diac.lib.7. Ab. Ursper. Pom.Læ.in Iustiniano. Pau.Emy.lib.1.de rc.Franc.

ATHALARICUS Gothorum Rex, Theodorico auo materno, (qui Gothorum primus in Italia imperauit 34. annis) iuuenis admodũ, nempe octo annorum, successit: huius immaturam ætate mater rexit, erudiendámque ciuilibus, priusquam bellicis artibus curauit: nam pater Eutharicus obierat. hic ætatis anno 16. imperij 8. decessit. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Two medallions above the text, engraved coins with legends. Left medallion: bust in helmet facing right; legend reads "AMALASVINTA" along the right edge and a partly legible "GOTHO..." along the left edge, the rest illegible. Right medallion: bust facing left with headband; legend reads "ATHALARICVS. GOTH. REX" along the top and "D.N. ATHALARIC" along the lower left, read from the scan. The ornament below the text is a decorative fleuron, not text. Running head "PARS SECVNDA." and page number "ioi" are printed at the top. The page number is printed in old lowercase numerals and reads as 101. Long s and u/v are normalised per the rules. The printed "Vrsper" has been written "Ursper", and "SECVNDA" as "SECUNDA", as u for vowel.
